title: Conscious and unconscious processing form a serial hierarchy

statements.text: Computational models of sensory metacognition fit data better when unconscious and conscious processes form a serial hierarchy than when they form two parallel channels. On this picture awareness depends on a late monitoring process that judges whether a first-order state carries reliable information.
